items: Call the Ancestor with {Stormkeeper} and follow right away with {Ascendance}, lined up with big pulls and boss burst windows

2825.m: 0.4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 진영: 호드

32182.m: 0.4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 진영: 얼라이언스

51505.m: 특성 · 0.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능

51886.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간
51886.d: 아군 대상에게 걸린 모든 저주 효과를 제거합니다.

57994.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간
57994.d: 강풍을 날려보내 대상의 주문 시전을 방해하고, 4초 동안 대상이 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 합니다.

60188.d: 극대화 공격 시 피해량 상승이 200%에서 (50 / 태고의 분노: 75 / 순환 고리: 65 + 200)%로 증가합니다.

77756.d: 화염 충격으로 주기적인 피해를 입히면 일정 확률로 용암 폭발의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화되고, 용암 폭발을 즉시 시전할 수 있게 됩니다.

79206.m: 특성 · 2.82% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간

108271.d: 영혼 일부를 안전한 정령계로 옮겨 12초 동안 받는 피해를 40%만큼 감소시킵니다.

114050.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간

15초 동안 화염의 승천자로 변신해 최대 6명의 주위 적에게 화염 충격을 즉시 시전하고 50%의 효율로 용암 폭발을 시전합니다.

117013.d: 원시 정령계로부터 대지, 불, 폭풍의 정령을 이끌어냅니다. 이들 정령은 일반 정령보다 80%만큼 더 강력하고, 추가 능력을 사용하며, 주술사가 직접 원시 불의 정령을 제어할 수 있습니다.

117014.m: 특성 · 0.55% (기본 마나 중) / 소용돌이 90 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
117014.d: 야생의 정기를 있는 그대로 받아들여, 적 대상에 (주문력의 201.25%)의 원소 피해를 입히고 10초 동안 자신의 치명타 및 극대화 또는 가속을 8%만큼, 혹은 특화를 (8 * 1.875)%만큼 증가시킵니다.

192058.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
192058.d: 대상 위치에 토템을 소환하여 주위 공기에서 전기 에너지를 흡수합니다. 토템은 2초 후에 폭발하여 8미터 내의 모든 적들을 3초 동안 기절시킵니다.

198103.d: 상급 대지의 정령을 불러내 보호를 받습니다. 추가로 아군을 보호하며, 높은 위협 수준을 생성하고 주기적으로 적을 도발합니다. 30초 동안 지속됩니다.

382886.d: 모든 화염 및 냉기 공격력이 3%만큼 증가합니다.

383013.d: 발 밑에 토템을 소환하여 6초 동안 1.5초마다 30미터 내에 있는 주위의 파티원 또는 공격대원의 독 효과를 모두 제거합니다.

443454.d:

2484.d: 20초 동안 대상 위치에 토템을 소환하여 10미터 내에 있는 적의 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

1: [차단] Put Wind Shear (12 sec) into the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy). Its short cooldown lets you cover two or more kicks in this pull.

[제어] When a low Spellsower starts running with Call The Grove, throw Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) in its path to hold it. Stormbringer build drops Earthgrab Totem (30 sec, 8 sec root) next to the Spellsower in advance.

[광역 피해] This is the pull where everything is stacked and Bloodlust goes out. If you are the group's lust, press Bloodlust/Heroism here, then follow Stormkeeper (1 min) with Ascendance (2 min with First Ascendant). Press Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec with Planes Traveler, 40% less damage taken for 12 sec) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers start Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast), kick one with Wind Shear, and if Capacitor Totem is back, throw it right away under the two stacked at the tank. The stun lands 2 sec later and stops the other cast too.

[광역 피해] If the Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) from pull 1 is not back for Spouting Floret, top yourself off with an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer build, 30 sec) or Nature's Swiftness (Stormbringer build, 1 min).
3: [제어] Two Radiant Spellsowers sit next to 12 Lashers. Stun a Spellsower running to the dormant Lasher pack with Capacitor Totem, or root it with Earthgrab Totem (Stormbringer build), to prevent Frantic Blooming (8 sec channel).

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher with its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108) is immune to crowd control, so do not waste Capacitor Totem on it. If the Stormkeeper (1 min) from pull 1 is back, fire the two empowered Lightning Bolts at that Lasher to break the shield first.
[광역 피해] Once the 12 Lashers are stacked at the tank, apply Flame Shock to 6 of them with Voltaic Blaze (10 sec) and place Earthquake in the middle of the pack.
5: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) with Wind Shear. If it goes off, the whole group is disoriented for 3 sec.

[제어] Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal plus knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec) can be stopped with a stun (Topicx). When a Saptor leaps, throw Capacitor Totem under it to stun it 2 sec later.

[광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first and Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later, so save the two Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightnings until the Grovekeeper is stacked too. Press Astral Shift for the earlier Spouting Floret.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Wind Shear, and if Wind Shear is spare, kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) too.

[광역 피해] The two Luminous Thornmaws have a lot of health and live long, so if Ascendance (2 min) is back, line it up with Stormkeeper on this pull. If you are inside a Thornmaw's Solar Breath (3 sec cast, 387930 Holy) cone, press Spiritwalker's Grace (2 min) and walk out while you keep casting.

[참고] While Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield (absorbs 500090) is up on the 5 beetles, every Earthquake and Chain Lightning hit returns 4849 Nature damage. If you lay down Earthquake for a long time before the shields break, press Astral Shift with it.
8: [제어] Stop both Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap by stunning them together with Capacitor Totem. If the two are apart, stop the one targeting you first.

[광역 피해] Use Astral Shift for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. If the Astral Shift from pull 7 (1 min 30 sec) is not back, survive with an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness.
10: [해제] When Potatoad Matriarch starts Toxic Spew (2 sec cast, 67888 Nature plus a 9 sec poison DoT), drop Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer build, 2 min) next to the group. It removes poison from one party member within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec (Wowhead). Leave the next Toxic Spew, and the poison in the Stormbringer build, to a party member who can remove it.
[우선 처치] Break Potadpole Eggs right away with instant Voltaic Blaze (always crits). On the high-health Matriarch, fire the two Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts and add Ascendance if it is back.
11: [차단] When all three Lightfeather Petalwings start Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast), kick one with Wind Shear and immediately throw Capacitor Totem under the other two stacked at the tank so the stun stops them 2 sec later.
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and use Gust of Wind (20 sec) to get out of Luminous Thornmaw's Solar Breath cone.
12: [우선 처치] The six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields (absorbs 600108) and become immune to crowd control. Stack the two Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightnings and Ascendance on this pull and break the shields together with Earthquake.
[차단] Split Light Bolt Volley from the two Radiant Spellsowers between Wind Shear and Capacitor Totem. Root a low Spellsower that runs off with Earthgrab Totem (Stormbringer build).
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with Wind Shear (12 sec).

[제어] If the seven Ravenous Descendants live long and the tank starts taking heavy damage, throw Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) under the pack. Three seconds without melee swings drops the 2 sec Ravenous Claws stacks.
[광역 피해] Once both Venom Leech packs are stacked too, apply Flame Shock to 6 targets with Voltaic Blaze (10 sec) and fire the two Chain Lightnings empowered by Stormkeeper (1 min).
2: [우선 처치] Fire the two Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts at the Ritual Chieftain to kill it first. Kick the Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Wind Shear.

[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec with Planes Traveler, 40% less damage taken for 12 sec) for Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb). Elemental Warding only reduces magic damage, so it does not help against this Physical hit.
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, kick one with Wind Shear. If kicks run short, throw Capacitor Totem right away under the Serpents stacked at the tank. The stun lands 2 sec later, inside the 4 sec cast.

[광역 피해] If the Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) from pull 2 is not back before Blood Sacrifice, use an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer build, 30 sec) or Nature's Swiftness (Stormbringer build, 1 min) to top yourself off.
4: [우선 처치] Pour the Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts into the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before several Blood Sacrifices land, and take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Wind Shear.
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Blood Sacrifice if it is back. If not, use an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Follow the two Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightnings with Ascendance (2 min with First Ascendant) and lay down Earthquake, but put Lava Burst into the Ritual Chieftain first to melt it.

[회피] For the two Twinfang Harrowers' Toxic Breath (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec) frontal, press Spiritwalker's Grace (2 min, cast while moving for 15 sec) and step to the side while you keep casting.
[광역 피해] When Paralyzing Shots DoTs overlap with Blood Sacrifice, press Astral Shift.
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Wind Shear, and stop Evolve (6 sec channel) with a Capacitor Totem stun. The same stun also stops the three Bloodletters' melee swings.
[참고] If Evolve finishes and grants its shield (absorbs 250045) and crowd-control immunity, remove that Magic effect with Purge.
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec).
8: [제어] When the four Bloodletters stack at the tank, stun them together for 3 sec with Capacitor Totem to delay the blood pools.
[광역 피해] If the Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) from pull 7 is not back before Rattle, survive with an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness.
9: [차단] If you, as a ranged player, take the far-left High Evolutionist, kick its Mass Envenom with Wind Shear (30 yd) so it walks over to the pack.
[우선 처치] Split the Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts between the two High Evolutionists to kill them before the second Mass Envenom. If an Evolve shield appears, remove it with Purge.
11: [차단] Kick your assigned High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Wind Shear, and when several channel Evolve together, stun them at once with Capacitor Totem.
[참고] If an unkicked Evolve gives an Evolutionist its shield, remove the shield and crowd-control immunity with Purge.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up the Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts and Ascendance on this mini-boss.

[제어] When Hatchlings from Infest chase a party member, drop Earthbind Totem (30 sec, 50% slow within 10 yards) where the group is stacked and stun them with Capacitor Totem (Wowhead). The Stormbringer build roots them with Earthgrab Totem (30 sec, 8 sec root).
13: [우선 처치] Fire the Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts at Ula'tek's Chosen, and do not pour Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning and Earthquake into the six Living Venoms at once. Save Wind Shear for the Chosen's Mass Envenom, which must be kicked every time.
[제어] During Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), stun the two Blades of the Altar with Capacitor Totem to stop their Laced Edge teleports, and press Astral Shift for your own damage.
14: [광역 피해] If the Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) and Capacitor Totem (1 min) from pull 13 are not back, survive Toxic Surge with an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness, and kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom with Wind Shear.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Wind Shear.
[회피] Get out of Twinfang Harrower's Toxic Breath frontal with Gust of Wind (20 sec), and when the four Blades of the Altar stack at the tank, stun them together with Capacitor Totem.
16: [우선 처치] Ula'tek's Chosen must die before the second Toxic Surge, so line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance on the Chosen, and kick its Mass Envenom with Wind Shear.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back and overlap with Toxic Surge. Press Astral Shift for the first overlap, and use an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness for the next Blood Sacrifice.
[제어] During Toxic Surge, stun the two Blades of the Altar with Capacitor Totem to stop their teleport attacks.

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull where Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard come together (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Bloodlust/Heroism here and line up the two Lightning Bolts empowered by Stormkeeper (1 min) and Ascendance (2 min with First Ascendant) on the Captain first.

[해제] In the Farseer build you are the poison dispeller. When Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison stacks build on the tank, drop Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min, removes poison from one party member within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec) next to the tank (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Take one of the two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) with Wind Shear (12 sec). If the player on the other Sayaad misses, throw Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) under that Sayaad to stop it.
4: [해제] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks build fast. If the Poison Cleansing Totem (2 min) from pull 1 is back, drop it next to the tank (Farseer build). If not, leave it to another party member who can remove poison.
5: [우선 처치] Fire the two Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts at the Massive Felwyrm to kill it first, and lay down Earthquake on the small Felwyrms.

[광역 피해] When Burning Fel from Over-infused (38793 Fire within 50 yards every 3 sec) overlaps with a Corroding Spittle DoT, press Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec with Planes Traveler, 40% less damage taken for 12 sec).
8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd-control immunity for 1 min) with Wind Shear. If both cast together, stop the other cast with Capacitor Totem. Elemental cannot remove the Enrage.
[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher goes into Demonic Frenzy below 50%, pour Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts and Ascendance into the Punisher to kill it fast.
9: [해제] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec) is a Curse, so remove it right away with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec) (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] If targeted by Drain Life, press Astral Shift. Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Wind Shear.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (30 sec channel) with Wind Shear.

[광역 피해] When the eight Demon Flies stack, apply Flame Shock with Voltaic Blaze (10 sec) and lay down Earthquake. Once Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, pour Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts into it.
11: [우선 처치] Felmaster Lucsei must die before more than three Blade Dances, so line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance on Lucsei (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec). For the next Blade Dance, top yourself off with an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer build, 30 sec) or Nature's Swiftness (Stormbringer build, 1 min).
13: [광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to everyone), and line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance on the Golem to cut the number of Slams.
[제어] Stop the six Unleashed Imps' Felfire Burst together with Capacitor Totem once they are stacked at the tank and finish them with Earthquake. Keep Wind Shear for Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage.
[회피] Dodge Fel Beam by walking backward with Spiritwalker's Grace (2 min, cast while moving for 15 sec) so you keep casting.
14: [차단] Spend Wind Shear on Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage and Fel Invoker's Health Funnel first, and stun the six Unleashed Imps together with Capacitor Totem.
15: [해제] Remove Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom right away with Cleanse Spirit. If targeted by Drain Life, press Astral Shift.
[우선 처치] Kill the Warlock first, then pour Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts into Shivan Punisher once it drops below 50%.
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem's AoE must end within two casts, so line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance on the Golem and press Astral Shift for the first Defiled Slam (Topicx). For the second Slam, use an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness.
[차단] Kick the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel with Wind Shear. Dodge Fel Beam by walking backward toward the last boss with Spiritwalker's Grace.

1: [광역 피해] This is the pull for the first Bloodlust and cooldowns (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Bloodlust/Heroism here, then follow Stormkeeper (1 min) with Ascendance (2 min with First Ascendant). Put Lava Burst into the Starvation Effigy first.
[해제] Starvation Effigy's Insatiable Hunger (stacking 15% max health reduction) is a Curse, so remove it with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec) (Wowhead). Clear the party member at two stacks first.
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec with Planes Traveler, 40% less damage taken for 12 sec) for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec).
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) first with Wind Shear (12 sec). If it goes off and the heal effect lands, remove it with Purge (Wowhead).

[해제] Remove the Insatiable Hunger curse with Cleanse Spirit, and if the Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) from pull 1 is not back for Feast of Misery, use an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer build, 30 sec) or Nature's Swiftness (Stormbringer build, 1 min).
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Wind Shear, and remove a landed heal effect with Purge.
[해제] Remove the Insatiable Hunger curse with Cleanse Spirit, and press Astral Shift for Feast of Misery.
4: [해제] Remove the Insatiable Hunger curse with Cleanse Spirit. Break the Starvation Effigy with Lava Burst and Voltaic Blaze (10 sec) before it casts the second curse.
[광역 피해] If Astral Shift is not back for Feast of Misery, use an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness.
5: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Wind Shear, and remove a missed heal effect with Purge.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). Use the two Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightnings and Ascendance here, and apply Flame Shock to 6 targets with Voltaic Blaze.

[차단] When both Earthwhisper Tenders start Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast), kick one with Wind Shear and immediately throw Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) under the two stacked at the tank. Remove any landed heal effect with Purge.
8: [우선 처치] Break Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield (24246 Nature to the group every 2 sec) fast by pressing Stormkeeper and pouring Lava Burst into it.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance with Bloodlust, and break Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward by pouring Lava Burst into it.
[차단] The two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% Haste and movement speed reduction) is a long cast, so Wind Shear (12 sec) can cover it more than once.
10: [차단] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust (Topicx). Kick the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar with Wind Shear, and if both cast together, throw Capacitor Totem right away so the stun stops them 2 sec later.
[위치] If Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge lands on you, press Spiritwalker's Grace (2 min, cast while moving for 15 sec) and move more than 4 yards away from the group while you keep casting.
11: [우선 처치] Line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance on Avatar of Determination first, then break Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward with Lava Burst.
13: [차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets) with Wind Shear.
[우선 처치] Break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem right away with instant Voltaic Blaze (10 sec, always crits) and Lava Burst.
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (stacking armor-ignoring Physical to the group).
14: [우선 처치] When both Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems are up, hit both totems at once with Voltaic Blaze and finish them with Lava Burst.

[제어] When a Bonded Beasttamer's pet chases a party member under Bestial Wrath, drop Earthbind Totem (30 sec, 50% slow within 10 yards) to slow it. The Stormbringer build roots it with Earthgrab Totem (30 sec, 8 sec root).
[광역 피해] If your route uses the third Bloodlust on this pull, line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance with it too (Topicx).
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers take turns with Primal Echo, so press Astral Shift for the first Echo and use an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness for the next one.
[광역 피해] This is a big pull at 85 trash. Use Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning and Ascendance, and use Voltaic Blaze on cooldown.
[차단] Kick the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Wind Shear, and break Magma Totems with Voltaic Blaze.
16: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

[우선 처치] In high keys where Bloodlust goes out here, line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance to kill Nanea before the third Volatile Totem wave (Topicx). Unless Nanea is around 10% health, break the totems first with Voltaic Blaze and Lava Burst.

1: [차단] Kick your assigned Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) with Wind Shear (12 sec). If you have no shaman assignment, take Voidtouched Magi's second Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yards).

[광역 피해] This pull gathers the first hallway up to the Magi and uses Bloodlust (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Bloodlust/Heroism and follow the two Chain Lightnings empowered by Stormkeeper (1 min) with Ascendance (2 min with First Ascendant).

[위치] If targeted by Null Eruption, press Spiritwalker's Grace (2 min, cast while moving for 15 sec), move out of the group while you keep casting, and press Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec with Planes Traveler, 40% less damage taken for 12 sec).
2: [우선 처치] When the three Orbs of Disruption appear, swap right away and break them with instant Lava Burst and Voltaic Blaze (10 sec). If even one orb finishes its cast, the group's Haste drops sharply.
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Thundering Storm's long group damage, and stand away from other ranged players because Forked Lightning bounces to 2 nearby targets.
3: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 158 trash. Use Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning and Ascendance and lay down Earthquake. Place Earthquake after the tank drags mobs out of Protective Turtle's Shell Guard so it is not wasted.
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec). Elemental Warding also reduces the magic damage you take by 8%.
[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, fire the two Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts at Brutok.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yards) is the most important kick in this area, so save Wind Shear for it. If the assigned kicker misses, throw Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yards after 2 sec) under the Screamer right away.
[위치] If targeted by Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), press Spiritwalker's Grace, move out of the group while you keep casting, and press Astral Shift.
6: [우선 처치] Save Stormkeeper and Ascendance for Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield and pour them in to break it fast (Topicx). Finish before it overlaps with Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak.
[광역 피해] If the shield breaks late and Brutal Slams (48491 Physical to the group every 1.5 sec, +10% per slam) stack up, press Astral Shift. Kick Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Wind Shear.
8: [우선 처치] This is a cooldown pull (Topicx). When Devouring Brutalizer starts Devour (9 sec cast), fire Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts and Lava Burst at the marked mob right away to kill it before the cast ends. Use Ascendance and Earthquake on the rest.
[차단] Spend Wind Shear on Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek first, and if it is spare, kick Voidminder's Mending Void (20 sec channel).
[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Dreadbellow (29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled).
9: [광역 피해] When the ten Scavenging Siphoids stack, apply Flame Shock with Voltaic Blaze and lay down Earthquake. Fire Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts at the Devour target.

[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Wind Shear, and if the Astral Shift (1 min 30 sec) from pull 8 is not back before Dreadbellow, use an instant Healing Surge via Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer build, 30 sec) or Nature's Swiftness (Stormbringer build, 1 min).
10: [우선 처치] Kill Devouring Brutalizer's Devour target first with Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts, then line up Ascendance on the Watchful Harrower chained in after it.
[광역 피해] When Dreadbellow and Void Beam overlap, press Astral Shift, and kick the two Voidminders' Mending Void with Wind Shear.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first pull of the dungeon, so use Bloodlust (Topicx). If party Bloodlust is on you, press Bloodlust/Heroism, then follow two Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightnings (1 min) with Ascendance (2 min with First Ascendant).

[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift (1.5 min with Planes Traveler, 40% damage reduction for 12 sec) for Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd). Elemental Warding also cuts magic damage taken by 8%. If Astral Shift is not back for the next cast, top yourself up in advance with an instant Healing Surge from Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer build, 30 sec) or Nature's Swiftness (Stormbringer build, 1 min).

[제어] Hold the Minion of Zul on the way with Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yd after 2 sec) and remove Bound by Shadow (Magic shield) with Purge. The Minion of Zul dies when the shield is removed.
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT) with Wind Shear (12 sec). If it goes off and the curse lands, remove it from party members with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec) (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] The corner pack is a cooldown pull (Topicx). Use Stormkeeper again and add Ascendance if it is back. Take Shadow Whirlwind with Astral Shift if it is back from pull 1, otherwise survive it with a Healing Surge made instant by Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness.
4: [차단] Put Queen Wasi's Bind Soul and Soul Bolt and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending into the Wind Shear rotation. If Unholy Mending finishes, remove the heal effect (Magic) with Purge (Wowhead).
[해제] When Guard Captain Atu casts Captain's Bulwark (30% less damage taken, Magic), Purge it off the mob that carries it.

[광역 피해] Use Stormkeeper only after the tank has aggro, and save Ascendance for the hardest pack, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins (Topicx). If Blood Drain (164870 Physical) comes while you carry the Sudden Rupture bleed, press Astral Shift, and when King Timalji's Bladestorm comes toward you, get out with Gust of Wind (20 sec).
5: [광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole group). While you back out of the pools, press Spiritwalker's Grace (2 min, cast while moving for 15 sec) to keep casting.
[참고] If you use Bloodlust here on a high key, line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance with it, and kill the pulled Embalming Fluids together with Earthquake and Chain Lightning.
6: [차단] Take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT on the whole group) with Wind Shear. If both cast at once, drop Capacitor Totem under them right away. The stun lands after 2 sec, inside the 4 sec cast.
7: [차단] On the other side, also take one Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge with Wind Shear, and if you did not use Capacitor Totem on pull 6, drop it on the other one. Elemental cannot remove diseases.
[광역 피해] When the eight Embalming Fluids are gathered, apply Flame Shock with Voltaic Blaze (10 sec) and place Earthquake.
9: [우선 처치] Shoot Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts and Lava Burst into the two Spectral Shamans first. If a Healing Tide Totem is already down, switch to the totem right away and break it.

[차단] Kick the two Phantom Hex Priests' Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) with Wind Shear, and if both cast at once, stun them together with Capacitor Totem (Topicx). Hex is a curse, so free a hexed party member right away with Cleanse Spirit (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] When Royal Berserker's Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds (12 sec Physical) stack up, press Astral Shift.
10: [우선 처치] On a four-Bloodlust route this pull is the third Bloodlust (Topicx). Put Stormkeeper and Ascendance into the Ghostly Brute and melt it first.

[회피] When Ghostly Brute starts Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby), get out of range with Gust of Wind. Kick the remaining Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Wind Shear and free a hexed party member with Cleanse Spirit.
12: [위치] As a ranged player, if you take the far Pool of Darkness (Topicx), step into the pool first and press Spiritwalker's Grace so you keep casting while you move.

[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Dark Revelation, use Gust of Wind to get more than 20 yd from the group and press Astral Shift for the explosion 5 sec later (473120 Shadow). If a Minion of Zul appears afterwards (Method), remove Bound by Shadow with Purge to kill it at once.

1: [제어] When the Tectonic Strike stacks from the four Deepstone Earthshapers get high on the tank, drop Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yd after 2 sec) under the Earthshapers (Topicx). Primal Juggernaut is immune to crowd control, so do not count it as a stun target.
[차단] Always kick the two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel, a shield that blocks crowd control) with Wind Shear (12 sec). Kick one and hand the other to the next kicker.

[우선 처치] This is a big pull gathered up to the entrance. Shoot Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts (1 min) and Lava Burst into the Primal Juggernaut first, then hit the rest with Ascendance (2 min with First Ascendant) and Earthquake. Press Astral Shift (1.5 min with Planes Traveler, 40% damage reduction for 12 sec) for Excavating Blast (106681 Nature within 60 yd plus an 8 sec DoT).
2: [차단] Kick the Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Wind Shear, and kick Frostbolt with the time left.

[우선 처치] Kill the Primal Juggernaut first with Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts. If Astral Shift from pull 1 is not back before Excavating Blast, survive the DoT with an instant Healing Surge from Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer build, 30 sec) or Nature's Swiftness (Stormbringer build, 1 min).
3: [차단] Kick the Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Wind Shear. Capacitor Totem stuns do not work on a mob that carries the Ice Shield.

[광역 피해] Defier Draghar is immune to crowd control. Steel Barrage deals Fire damage to the whole group on every strike (24246 within 60 yd), so press Astral Shift when the strikes stack, on top of the 8% magic damage reduction from Elemental Warding. If Stormkeeper is back, fire two empowered Lightning Bolts into Draghar.
5: [차단] Use Wind Shear on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first (Topicx).

[제어] The two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) cannot be interrupted, so stop it by stunning them with Capacitor Totem (Topicx). The stun lands 2 sec later, so throw it as soon as the channel starts.

[해제] When an Ashseer Flamelasher casts Blaze of Glory (15 sec of ember volleys, Magic) as it dies, remove it with Purge (Wowhead). When Blazebound Destroyer casts Burnout (20 yd) on death, get out with Gust of Wind (20 sec).
6: [우선 처치] Flamegullet is immune to crowd control and Molten Blood keeps raising party damage below 50%. On +17 and above, Bloodlust goes at 50% (Topicx), so if party Bloodlust is on you, pour Stormkeeper and Ascendance in together with Bloodlust/Heroism at that point.

[회피] If you are targeted by Flame Breath (4 sec cast, frontal Fire), press Spiritwalker's Grace (2 min, cast while moving for 15 sec) and step sideways while you keep casting. Stop the Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Capacitor Totem and remove Blaze of Glory with Purge.
7: [제어] Stop the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage with Capacitor Totem if it is back. If the Capacitor Totem (1 min) used on pulls 5 and 6 is not ready yet, hand it to another stunner and use Wind Shear on the Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt.
[해제] Remove a dying Flamelasher's Blaze of Glory with Purge. Press Astral Shift for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (party Fire damage plus a DoT).
8: [제어] Stop the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage with Capacitor Totem and remove the Blaze of Glory they cast on death with Purge. Use Wind Shear on the Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt.
10: [광역 피해] When the six Storm Warriors are gathered, apply Flame Shock with Voltaic Blaze (10 sec) and use Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning and Earthquake. You take 8% less from Thunderous Stomp (53340 Nature within 60 yd) thanks to Elemental Warding.

[위치] Press Astral Shift if you are targeted by Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec). Stop the Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Capacitor Totem and remove Blaze of Glory with Purge.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Wind Shear. This stretch is chain-pulled without stopping (Topicx), so keep Astral Shift for when you are targeted by Lightning Torrent.
12: [우선 처치] High Channeler Ryvati is immune to crowd control. While Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of max health) is up the group takes Nature damage every sec, and if it expires a 60 yd 4 sec stun goes off, so pour Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts, Lava Burst and Ascendance into the shield to break it. If your team uses Bloodlust on Ryvati on high keys (Topicx), line up Bloodlust/Heroism there.

[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift if the shield breaks late and the Nature damage piles up, or if you are targeted by Lightning Torrent. The Stormcloud Barrier (Magic shield) on the Primal Thunderclouds Ryvati summons can be removed with Purge (Wowhead).

1: [차단] Put Wind Shear (12 sec) into the rotation for the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature). While Sandfury Stonefist casts Ground Pound (4 sec cast), hold Wind Shear and make sure you kick the Lightning Bolt that comes then (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift (1.5 min with Planes Traveler, 40% damage reduction for 12 sec) for Ground Pound (156627 Physical within 60 yd plus a knockback). Pour Stormkeeper (1 min), Lava Burst and Ascendance (2 min with First Ascendant) into Sandfury Stonefist, which is immune to crowd control, to kill it first.

[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Capacitor Totem (1 min, 3 sec stun within 8 yd after 2 sec). If Shrouded Fang's Poisoned Cheap Shot (Poison, 5 sec stun) lands, clear it with Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer build, 2 min) (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Put the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt into the Wind Shear rotation, and kick the Lightning Bolt cast during Ground Pound first (Topicx).

[광역 피해] If Astral Shift from pull 1 is not back before Ground Pound, top yourself up in advance with an instant Healing Surge from Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer build, 30 sec) or Nature's Swiftness (Stormbringer build, 1 min). Clear the two Shrouded Fangs' Poisoned Cheap Shot with Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer build).
4: [우선 처치] Do not leave the Sand-Sworn Rider alive for long (Topicx). Use Stormkeeper and Lava Burst on the Rider first. Swarming Krolusks adds run at ranged players standing far away, so if they come at you, drop Earthbind Totem (30 sec, 50% slow within 10 yd) at your feet and move toward the tank.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Wind Shear, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Capacitor Totem.
5: [차단] If the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt lands on someone hit by a Krolusk leap or Cytotoxin, that player dies (Topicx). Use Wind Shear on this Lightning Bolt first, and if both cast at once, stun them together with Capacitor Totem.

[광역 피해] This is a big pull worth 91 trash. Use Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning and Ascendance and place Earthquake. When Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleeds (6 sec Physical) stack up, press Astral Shift.
6: [차단] One player is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast) (Topicx). Take that job with Wind Shear, and since Addle Mind is a curse, free an affected party member with Cleanse Spirit (8 sec) (Wowhead).
[차단] Also put Brood Tender's Venom Bolt (116379 Nature on a random target) into the Wind Shear rotation.
7: [차단] Kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Wind Shear so it does not land on top of the Cytotoxin poison (Topicx). With three Poisonous Vipers, when Cytotoxin is on several players, drop Poison Cleansing Totem (removes poison every 1.5 sec for 6 sec) in the middle of the group (Farseer build).
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Capacitor Totem, and free a party member caught by Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind with Cleanse Spirit.
9: [해제] When the two Agitated Nimbuses stack Accumulate Charge (8% more damage done, 3 stacks, Magic), remove it with Purge (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole group). Elemental Warding also cuts magic damage taken by 8%. While the group is taking damage, make sure you kick Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt with Wind Shear (Topicx).
10: [차단] Stop the two Imbued Stormcallers before gathering the other mobs (Topicx). Kick one with Wind Shear and stun the other together with Capacitor Totem.

[광역 피해] If Astral Shift from pull 9 is not back for Release Charge, top yourself up in advance with a Healing Surge made instant by Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness. Remove Agitated Nimbus's Accumulate Charge with Purge, and use Chain Lightning and Earthquake on the four Static Anomalies.
12: [차단] Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel stops the orb from charging, so kick it with Wind Shear. Stun the Disruptor on the other side with Capacitor Totem to hold it for a moment (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Press Astral Shift for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT). Place Earthquake under the Orb Watcher so it also hits the gathered Faithless Conscripts (Topicx).
13: [차단] Split the two Temple Disruptors' Essence Disruption between Wind Shear and Capacitor Totem and protect the orb until it reaches 100% (Topicx). If Astral Shift from pull 12 is not back yet, survive the Caustic Stomp DoT with a Healing Surge made instant by Ancestral Swiftness or Nature's Swiftness.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) can only be stopped by kicks because the Hexxer is immune to crowd control. Save Wind Shear for it.

[제어] Slow the four Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer with Earthbind Totem (Wowhead) and stun them with Capacitor Totem. In the Stormbringer build, root them with Earthgrab Totem (30 sec, 8 sec root). Kill them together with the gathered Faithless Conscripts using Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning and Earthquake (Topicx).
